From a434e2398ae9ac5ccf3ec5ec7d50638a38ae95f6 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Karel Zak <kzak@redhat.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2015 09:53:46 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] raw: fix raw query

Bug introduced by commit cd121363.

References: https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=1181444
Signed-off-by: Karel Zak <kzak@redhat.com>

diff --git a/disk-utils/raw.c b/disk-utils/raw.c
index cc6690145..d29ff1ba3 100644
--- a/disk-utils/raw.c
+++ b/disk-utils/raw.c
@@ -224,7 +224,7 @@ static int query(int minor_raw, const char *raw_name, int quiet)
 	if (raw_name) {
 		struct stat statbuf;
 
-		if (!stat(raw_name, &statbuf))
+		if (stat(raw_name, &statbuf) != 0)
 			err(EXIT_RAW_ACCESS,
 			    _("Cannot locate raw device '%s'"), raw_name);
 		if (!S_ISCHR(statbuf.st_mode))
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `disk-utils/raw.c`**
   - The condition in the `query` function was modified. 
   - The original line:
     ```c
     if (!stat(raw_name, &statbuf))
     ```
     was changed to:
     ```c
     if (stat(raw_name, &statbuf) != 0)
     ```
   - This change alters the logic of error checking for the `stat` function, ensuring that an error is reported when `stat` fails (i.e., when it returns a non-zero value).

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `disk-utils/raw.c` directly addresses a bug introduced by a previous commit (cd121363). The change corrects the logic for checking the existence of a raw device by ensuring that an error is raised when the `stat` function fails, rather than when it succeeds. This fix is crucial for proper error handling in the raw query functionality, thereby improving the robustness of the code.
